Deflation-based permutation p-values for canonical correlations

Source: R/cca_pvalues.r
cca_pvalues.Rd

Computes per-component permutation p-values for CCA using sequential deflation: after each accepted canonical variate pair, the shared variance is projected out of both matrices before testing the next component. This gives p-values that are conditional on earlier components, making them more interpretable than marginal permutation p-values.

cca_pvalues(
  X,
  Y,
  K = NULL,
  nperm = 1000L,
  statistic = c("abs_cor", "cor"),
  method = c("stepdown", "unadjusted"),
  blocks = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

X

Numeric matrix, cells x shape features. Should already be scaled if scaling is desired (e.g. pass the same scale(X) used for run_cca).

Y

Numeric matrix, cells x NMF factors. Same scaling note as X.

K

Integer. Number of canonical components to test. Defaults to min(ncol(X), ncol(Y)).

nperm

Integer. Number of permutations. Default 1000.

statistic

Character. Test statistic: "abs_cor" (default) or "cor".

method

Character. "stepdown" (default) enforces monotone p-values via cumulative max across components. "unadjusted" returns raw per-component p-values.

blocks

Optional integer or factor vector of length nrow(X). When supplied, rows are permuted within blocks rather than globally (useful for permuting within FOV or slide).

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility.

verbose

Logical. Print progress. Default TRUE.

Value

A list with:

pvalues

Named numeric vector of length K (names: CC1, CC2, ...).

raw_p

Raw (pre-monotone) p-values. Identical to pvalues when method = "unadjusted".

obs_cancor

Observed deflated canonical correlations, length K.

counts

Exceedance counts, length K.

method

The method used.

meta

List of call parameters for provenance.

Details

Built entirely on run_cca; does not use CCA::rcc, CCA::cc, or any external CCA implementation.

See also

run_cca, link_shape_and_factors
